primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: Percent changes in 17-OHP were assessed through the collection of samples from 0600 hours to 1000 hours both prior to study drug administration (i.e., at baseline) and after 14 days of study drug dosing. The 3 samples collected during this morning window at each visit were averaged and used to determine the percent change from baseline.
